digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and RUF rule family enablement
propositions: Enable the RUF rule family in the global Ruff configuration by adding it to [tool.ruff.lint].select and defer only RUF001, RUF002, and RUF003 via [tool.ruff.lint].ignore due to intentional Unicode in prose and UI.

Remediate 179 actionable RUF diagnostics from the baseline narrow-census command across src/rebar and tests, using safe mechanical fixes for RUF059/RUF005/RUF007/RUF046/RUF022/RUF023/RUF019/RUF102 and manual fixes for RUF012/RUF043/RUF028/RUF034.

Extend tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py to assert that [tool.ruff.lint].select includes RUF, [tool.ruff.lint].ignore is exactly {RUF001, RUF002, RUF003}, extend-ignore is absent, and per-file-ignores contains no RUF codes.
Remove stale RUF100 suppressions across the codebase under the final full configured Ruff rule set; do not use narrow-selection RUF100 artifact counts to drive removals.
Verify that ruff check --select RUF --ignore RUF001,RUF002,RUF003,RUF100 src/rebar tests exits 0 after remediation and ruff check src tests exits 0 with no stale noqa codes.
Ensure all acceptance criteria pass including make lint and the default test tier against current origin/main after remediation.
